# CANDIDATE: VOLUME_WICK_REJECTION_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A pronounced lower wick on heavy volume signals buying pressure at support, especially when price is already above the VWAP and EMA ribbon. This edge exists because heavy volume on a long lower wick indicates strong institutional or algorithmic buying interest that can reverse short-term downward pressure, particularly when the price is above key bullish indicators (VWAP and EMA ribbon) suggesting the market is in a bullish alignment.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When a bar forms a lower wick ≥2× its body size, volume >2× the 20‑bar average volume, and price is above both VWAP and the EMA ribbon (bullish alignment), enter long at the close of that bar. Exit: Chart‑stop at the low of the wick, TP1 at 2R (where R = distance from entry to chart stop), runner trail using a chandelier exit (ATR×3). Regime filter: Only active when price is above the 50‑EMA and VIX <22 to avoid choppy, low-volume environments.
